components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single aqua action signal for creation and confirmation.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b9286; color: #062d2b; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 0; transition: background 200ms ease-out, color 200ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #075e5a; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #50dec9; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Quiet filled field with a structural stroke and aqua focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #142321; border: 1px solid #dbe5e2; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 200ms ease-out, box-shadow 200ms ease-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #91a09d; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #0b9286; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(18 179 160 / 0.2); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Sticky context bar with a deep ink brand mark and quiet icon actions.
components.html: TaskBoard
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 64px; border-bottom: 1px solid #dbe5e2; background: rgb(244 247 246 / 0.88); color: #142321; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 12px; background: #142321; color: #50dec9; }

components.name: Card
components.description: A quiet raised container that uses line first and soft ambient depth.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: #142321; border: 1px solid #dbe5e2; border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 16px 40px rgb(20 35 33 / 0.07); } .ds-card:hover { border-color: #0b9286; }

narrative.overview: TaskBoard is a calm operating surface for collaborative work. Cool ink surfaces and a single aqua signal keep the interface quiet at rest while progress, priority, presence, and next actions carry the visual weight.
keyCharacteristics: Thin structural borders with soft ambient elevation

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Aqua is the attention signal; keep it concentrated on actions, current context, presence, and selected states.

rules.name: The Border-First Rule
rules.body: Structural lines establish hierarchy; elevation supports interaction and layering rather than replacing the grid.

dos: Do use aqua sparingly for focus, action, live presence, and selected states.
Do keep surfaces quiet and let hierarchy come from spacing, type, and structural lines.
Do maintain the light and dark surface relationships together.
donts: Don't return to a generic blue primary palette.
Don't use gradients or decorative grid textures as a substitute for hierarchy.
Don't stack nested rounded cards when a clear section or list will do.
